models.code:
class Customer(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'customer'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String)
    balance = Column(Decimal, default=0)
    credit_limit = Column(Decimal, default=1000)
models.description: A class containing Customer details, its balance and credit limit.
models.name: Customer

models.code:
class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'order'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('customer.id'))
    amount_total = Column(Decimal, default=0)
    date_shipped = Column(DateTime)
    notes = Column(String)
models.description: A class representing an order with an amount, shipment date and associated customer.
models.name: Order

models.code:
class Item(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'item'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('order.id'))
    product_id = Column(Integer, ForeignKey('product.id'))
    quantity = Column(Integer, default=1)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal, default=0)
    amount = Column(Decimal, default=0)
models.description: Items associate with orders having quantity and unit price values.
models.name: Item

models.code:
class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = 'product'

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True)
    name = Column(String)
    unit_price = Column(Decimal)
models.description: A product class which has unit price and name.
models.name: Product

rules.name: Customer Balance Constraint
rules.description: Customer's balance should not exceed credit limit.
rules.code:
Rule.constraint(validate=Customer,
                 as_condition=lambda row: row.balance <= row.credit_limit,
                 error_msg="Customer balance ({row.balance}) exceeds credit limit ({row.credit_limit})")

rules.name: Customer Balance Sum
rules.description: Calculate the balance of all orders with no shipped date for a customer.
rules.code: Rule.sum(derive=Customer.balance, as_sum_of=Order.amount_total, where=lambda row: row.date_shipped is None)
